parties:
Mominuddin Howladar & Others
Vs.
Chutu Bibi
full_judgment:
Sultan Hossain Khan, J.:- This appeal at the instance of the defendants is directed against the judgment and decree passed by the District Judge, Khulna reversing those of the learned Munsif in a suit for declaration that the Kabala was void, fraudulent and without consideration. 

 6. On appeal the learned District Judge reversed the finding of the learned Munsif and decreed the suit. This appeal is directed against the aforesaid decision of the learned District Judge. 

 12. The appeal must therefore, succeed on the ground of non-maintainability of the suit under section 42 of the Specific Relief Act. In view of my discussion above this appeal is allowed. The judgment and decree of the learned District Judge are set aside. The suit is dismissed on the ground that it is not maintainable under section 42 of the Specific Relief Act. I make no order as to costs of this appeal.
